input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no hits, and the outline contains no insurance heading; the miscellaneous provisions run from Section 13 through Section 30 (Force Majeure) and then straight to the signature block, so no insurance covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement. This is material rather than a drafting nicety because TrueLink is a hosting vendor: it hosts the Web Site, receives and uploads Client Content (§ 1.b), and transmits and archives Credit Data consisting of borrower and loan-applicant credit information from TransUnion, Equifax and Experian (§ 1.d). A vendor that processes personal financial data with no insurance at all is walk-away territory under the rule, and neither the preferred nor the fallback position (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is met. The gap is also not cured elsewhere: TrueLink's indemnity in § 12.b is uncapped-by-insurance and § 12 caps its liability for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 at 12 months' hosting and support fees, so we have no funded backstop for a data incident. Proposed new Section 31 inserted after § 30 (before the signature block) with the preferred package — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request — using the Agreement's own defined terms (Client Content, Credit Data). The fallback of E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is offered in the comment if TrueLink pushes back on limits.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry standard CGL, E&O and cyber liability insurance with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though TrueLink hosts the Web Site and processes Client Content and borrower Credit Data, so we added our standard coverage package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M) with certificates on request. If helpful we can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000, covering TrueLink's processing of Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
